premises.text: Consumer-product marketers waste roughly half of large ad budgets because they cannot tell converters from already-loyal buyers and still rely on untargeted coupons
premises.evidence_span: they know 50% of that budget is misspent and wasted on the wrong customers

premises.text: Users zap product barcodes to check in and share with friends on Facebook and Twitter, including in-store at decision time
premises.evidence_span: We want you to zap the barcode, check in, and then share it with your friends and followers on Facebook and Twitter

premises.text: Check-ins unlock sarcastic dragon quips and comic-book adventures tied to product combinations, wrapping marketing in a game
premises.evidence_span: as you check into different combinations of products, you unlock these comic books

premises.text: Product Fanship leaderboards let users compete for top status on favorite brands
premises.evidence_span: for your favorite products, we have product leaderboards, which we call Fanships

premises.text: Check-in behavior gives consumer-product marketers the targeting tools to reward loyalty versus converting switchers
premises.evidence_span: giving consumer product marketers the targeting tools that they need

value.text: Reinvent how consumer product companies market to customers with targeted, game-wrapped engagement
value.evidence_span: fundamentally reinvent how consumer product companies market to their customers

secondary_value.text: Fun product check-in game that hooks consumers
secondary_value.evidence_span: product check-in game with a twist

causal_links.evidence_span: the fun really starts after the product check-in
By finally giving consumer product marketers the targeting tools that they need, and wrapping the whole thing in this fun gaming experience

notes: CPG waste/no-targeting/coupon examples folded as one problem-set. Barcode check-in, comics/quips, and Fanships split as distinct consumer engagement jobs (tie-break split). Marketer targeting kept as separately revisable B2B path enabled by check-ins.
